text:
anya: Heads-up: kicking off a config-only unpin for routing + batching tweaks in the midnight change window (23:50-00:20 UTC). Canary staged: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Watch p95, kvcache_free_pct, OOMs.

deploy-bot: DeployBot initiating canary 7832109999 for config cfg-midnight-unpin-2026. Canary phases scheduled: 0.5% (+5m) -> 5% (+12m) -> 25% (+20m) -> 100% (+30m). Auto-smoke tests started.

sam: Quick ask: is per-tenant max_batch changing? Need to know memory delta.

anya: Yes: max_batch 16 -> 10, per-tenant concurrency floor enforced at 2. Also routing timeout lowered 1500ms -> 1000ms. Geo weights: shift 5% from ap-south -> eu-west to smooth load.

jess: Abort conditions I want in play: p95 > 1.35x baseline sustained 3m, any OOM in inference pods, kvcache_free_pct drop > 20% absolute. If abort, pin route to model v3 and run emergency rollback.

ops-oncall: I'll silence noisy alerts during roll and watch paging rules. If we hit abort, I'll trigger the rollback command below.

anya: Rollback/runbook snippet in thread: ```
rbctl rollback cfg-midnight-unpin-2026
deploybot pin-route --route=global --model=v3
ops-oncall notify --channel=oncall
```

deploy-bot: Canary at 0.5% (7832110020). Smoke results: canary-smoke PASS 6/6, p95 155ms (baseline 150ms), error_rate 0.04% -> 0.05%, kvcache_free_pct 84% -> 82%. No OOMs.

sam: Memory looks fine for batch drop. Good. Proceed to 5%.

deploy-bot: Progressing to 5% (7832110040). Snapshot: p95 162ms, error_rate 0.06%, kvcache_free_pct 80%. No OOMs or Docker restarts.

jess: Holding to observe tails for 6m. If p95 crosses 200ms, abort.

ops-oncall: Noted. I'll keep alerts muted for non-actionable noise.

deploy-bot: Advancing to 25% (7832110050). Metrics: p95 170ms, p99 420ms (baseline p99 410ms), error_rate 0.08%, kvcache_free_pct 78%. No OOMs.

anya: Update release notes line: "config: reduce max_batch per-tenant 16->10; lower routing timeout 1500ms->1000ms; geo weight rebalance for eu-west; enforce tenant concurrency floor=2." Add fallback note.

sam: Add: "fallback policy: automatic fallback to cpu-quant-v1 when tail latency spikes for a tenant."

jess: Looks safe. Keep canary tag for 24h and monitor SLOs for 2h closely.

ops-oncall: If anything weird, use the rollback snippet. I'm on pager duty for next hour.

deploy-bot: Canary complete 100% at 7832110060. Final metrics: p95 158ms, p99 405ms, error_rate 0.07%, kvcache_free_pct 79%. No aborts, no restarts.

anya: Nice. Release notes pushed to internal-releases/docs. Post-deploy checklist: monitor dashboards 2h, keep canary tag for 24h, leave rollback commands pinned. Thanks all :tada:
